data.one_liner: Dart/Flutter library for converting colors using the perceptually uniform HSLuv and HPLuv spaces.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions and high‑level classes to convert between RGB, HSLuv, HPLuv, LCH, LUV, XYZ and hex representations. Includes a Color extension for easy use with Flutter's Color type.
use_when: You need perceptually uniform color manipulation in a Flutter app
You want to generate accessible color palettes based on human‑friendly color spaces
avoid_when: You only need basic RGB/HSV conversions and want a smaller dependency
You require a full UI color picker library
strengths: Accurate reference implementation with extensive conversion functions
Works directly with dart:ui Color, no extra dependencies
Supports both low‑level list APIs and high‑level Color extensions
weaknesses: Only color conversion, no UI components for picking colors
Adds a dependency on Flutter even for pure Dart use
